definitions.gloss: central pillar of a traditional Japanese house
definitions.explanation: The main structural pillar in a traditional Japanese building, typically the thickest and strongest column supporting the entire structure.
Figuratively, the person who is the main support of a family, organization, or team. The one everyone depends on.

examples.japanese: この{大黒柱|だいこくばしら}は{太|ふと}い。
{古|ふる}い{家|いえ}の{大黒柱|だいこくばしら}には{傷|きず}が{刻|きざ}まれていた。
examples.english: The central pillar of the old house had marks carved into it.

examples.japanese: {築|ちく}{百年|ひゃくねん}の{民家|みんか}の{大黒柱|だいこくばしら}は{今|いま}も{家|いえ}を{支|ささ}えている。
examples.english: The central pillar of the hundred-year-old farmhouse still supports the building.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{家族|かぞく}の{大黒柱|だいこくばしら}だ。
examples.english: My father is the breadwinner of the family.

examples.japanese: チームの{大黒柱|だいこくばしら}が{怪我|けが}で{欠場|けつじょう}した。
examples.english: The team's key player was absent due to injury.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}はこの{会社|かいしゃ}の{大黒柱|だいこくばしら}として{長年|ながねん}{活躍|かつやく}してきた。
examples.english: She has been active for many years as the mainstay of this company.

notes: Named after {大黒天|だいこくてん} (Daikokuten), the god of wealth and prosperity. In traditional Japanese houses, the {大黒柱|だいこくばしら} was positioned near the center of the home and was both structurally and symbolically important. The figurative sense (breadwinner, mainstay) is more common in everyday conversation. Collocations: {家族|かぞく}の{大黒柱|だいこくばしら} (family breadwinner), チームの{大黒柱|だいこくばしら} (team's key player), {大黒柱|だいこくばしら}を{失|うしな}う (to lose one's mainstay).
